Based on my search, here's what I found about watching MSNBC (now rebranded as **MS NOW**) live streaming online:

## Official and Legal Streaming Options

**Peacock (NBCUniversal's streaming service)**
- MSNBC/MS NOW is available on Peacock, which offers both free and premium tiers
- Go to www.peacock.com to sign up
- The free plan has limited content; premium plans offer full live streaming access

**Live TV Streaming Services** (require subscription, but offer free trials):
- **YouTube TV** – carries MS NOW in its channel lineup
- **Hulu + Live TV** – includes MSNBC/MS NOW
- **Sling TV** – offers MSNBC in its packages, with free trial available
- **DIRECTV Stream** – includes the channel

## Important Note: MSNBC Has Rebranded to MS NOW

As of November 2025, MSNBC was rebranded as **"MS NOW"** (My Source for News, Opinion, and the World) due to Comcast's spin-off into a new entity called Versant. The same programming, hosts, and content continue under this new name, though the NBC peacock logo is no longer used.

## Free Streaming Websites (Unofficial)

Several third-party websites claim to offer free MSNBC/MS NOW live streams without cable login:
- **Live News Chat** (livenewschat.eu) – claims free HD streaming with no signup required
- **US News On** (usnewson.com) – offers what they describe as free live streaming
- **Live News Time** (livenewstime.com) – claims free streaming available
- **NewsLive.com** – states viewers can watch MSNBC online for free

**Caution**: These unofficial free streaming sites may operate in legal gray areas, often contain extensive advertising, and may not be authorized distributors. Video quality and reliability can vary significantly.

## MSNBC Mobile App

The official MSNBC app (now MS NOW app) allows live streaming, but **requires authentication** through a participating cable, satellite, or streaming TV provider. It offers:
- Live real-time streaming (for authenticated subscribers)
- On-demand episodes of shows like *The Rachel Maddow Show*, *Morning Joe*, *All In with Chris Hayes*, etc.
- Video clips (some available without subscription)

## Summary

| Method | Cost | Requirements |
|--------|------|--------------|
| Peacock (Premium) | Subscription | Account signup |
| YouTube TV, Hulu + Live TV, Sling TV, etc. | Subscription | Free trial available |
| Official MSNBC/MS NOW app | Free with TV provider login | Cable/streaming subscription |
| Third-party websites | Free | No login (unofficial, use caution) |

For the most reliable and legal experience, Peacock or a legitimate live TV streaming service with a free trial is recommended.

Sources:
1. https://usnewson.com/watch/msnbc-live
2. https://livenewschat.eu/msnbc-live-stream/
3. https://old.dlg.org/lead-digest/how-to-stream-msnbc-live-your-guide-1767647831
4. https://www.adweek.com/lostremote/msnbc-launches-new-app-with-live-streaming-on-demand-clips/
5. https://nguoiviet.tv/msnbc/
6. https://www.madpenguin.org/how-to-stream-msnbc-live-on-peacock/
7. https://livenewstime.com/msnbc-live/
8. https://www.newslive.com/american/msnbc-news-live.html
